_comment: R3′ pre-registration (phase-08b Step-1 amendment, kongming-261028-1220): every value is configuration, none comes from a dry run. The TS xApp decides from the harness predictor's answer; the predictor reads DRB.PdcpSduVolumeDL per gNB cell from Influx over the window [T-15, T] certified by N6 (check-n6-influx-window.py) and answers per cell the window sum (persistence forecast; 3GPP TS 28.552 §5.1.2.1.1.1 is a cumulative counter per granularity period, so a sum over periods is the volume of 1.6 s). Radio config = R2's (enb:1, gnb:2, gnb:3, NoAuto, simTime 10, RngRun 1, UL off). The schedule (r3p-schedule.json) is formed only from the dry run by the template below; changing anything here after the run that uses it is T3.

formula.dl: for each gNB cell c: the sum of DRB.PdcpSduVolumeDL(c, s) for s in [T-15, T] (integer kbit per 1.6 s)
formula.order: the serving gNB cell first (the gNB whose UeMetrics row at seq T lists the IMSI), then the others by ascending nodeId
formula.bounds: 0 <= dl <= 2147483647 (the TS xApp stores int), else fail closed

decisionMirror.source: ric-app-ts@19e169b src/ts_xapp/ts_xapp.cpp:689-728 (with the Testbed patches: A1 payload parsing, default RMR handler)

domain.rule: tLo = rampGuard + window.length - 1; tHi = config.samples - 1 - tailGuard; every IMSI at every T in [tLo, tHi]

n1.imsi: the lowest none-eligible IMSI in stage A at the first step of [step, step + slot] that has one whose swapped observations are handover-eligible (20 * serving_dl >= 23 * other_dl), so the observation change can give its pre-registered result

h1.imsi: the lowest handover-eligible IMSI in stage A, same slot rule

m1.decision: stage B's eligible decision for h1's IMSI at the first step of [h1 + offset, h1 + offset + slot] where it is eligible

stageB.inject: h1's control at h1's step via the target gNB (deviation P1)

observationChange.mode: RIC-free predictor replay on each live run's certified windows
observationChange.transform: swap DRB.PdcpSduVolumeDL between gNB nodes 2 and 3 at every seq of the window; membership unchanged

calibration._comment: W calibration: R2's fixed-prediction block (r2-scenario.json calibration: 25 positives from step 10 every 3 steps, IMSIs round robin, each to the cell it is not on) run through the R3′ prepare path: N6 for the triggered IMSI (its window clipped at seq 0, because the block starts at step 10), then a per-trigger PUT of the fixed answer instead of the predictor's. W = max(1 s, 3 x L_max).
